key_insight: GINNGER learns thermodynamic generators rather than constitutive operators, yielding complex-fluid models that obey the first and second laws of thermodynamics by construction.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports transferable constitutive modeling of polymeric fluids across deformation protocols and flow geometries without prescribing phenomenological equations.
method: Embed GENERIC thermodynamic structure into neural-network learning.
Represent microstructural states in the polymer conformation tensor’s intrinsic eigenspace.
Combine shear, extensional, and mixed-flow data to discover one constitutive model.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation with high-fidelity simulations, accurate constitutive reconstruction, and prediction of complex flow fields in previously unseen geometries.
watch_item: Experimental validation and quantitative accuracy are not reported in the abstract, leaving real-world robustness to be established.
paper_title: A GENERIC-Informed Neural Network for Generative Rheology
